newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Port conditions - Bangladesh - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions - Bangladesh - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Chittagong, Dec 5 - A weather office bulletin said a cyclone over the West-Central Bay of Bengal and the adjoining area moved further north-west and was about 1120 kms south-west of Khulna at 1500 local time on Dec 4 on its way to making landfall around Andhra Pradesh. The ports of Chittagong, Cox's Bazar and Mongla advised to keep distant caution signal no 2 hoisted.
Chittagong, Dec 5 - Discharge of cargo from vessels in port and delivery from port premises suspended from 2100, Dec 4 due to a labour dispute.
